data.value: A compact running log of what has shipped in Trading Dashboard, starting with the latest snapshot on April 3, 2026.

data.name: Summary.Description
data.value: Use this page as the daily release note feed and add the next update above the current one.

data.name: Entry.Description.CurrentSnapshot
data.value: The product moved from core COT report flows into a more polished web experience with stronger hosting and delivery foundations.

data.name: Entry.Highlight.1
data.value: Rolled out a Tradexy-style homepage and main layout, including restored COT navigation and language switching.

data.name: Entry.Highlight.2
data.value: Added market directory and grouped markets pages so users can reach COT and COT Legacy reports faster.

data.name: Entry.Highlight.3
data.value: Expanded the report experience with summary stats, reusable long-short charts, and a selectable net-position chart with history filters.

data.name: Entry.Highlight.4
data.value: Improved data reliability by loading report pages from collected JSON snapshots and handling historical sync edge cases.

data.name: Entry.Highlight.5
data.value: Strengthened delivery with a MAUI Blazor Hybrid host plus updated GitLab CI steps for deploy and unit-test coverage.
